description: Read the profile's Autopilot: whether it is `on`, its posting times (`rules`), how a post goes out (`approval`: required waits for a person's ok, tacit goes out unless someone steps in, none goes out on its own, prepared `noticeHours` ahead), the saved ideas it uses first (`ideas`), its standing `instruction`, the next slots with what it would post in each (`preview`), the posts waiting for someone's ok (`waitingIds`), and `gate`, which says why it cannot run as set (null when it can). It only reads: changing Autopilot stays with a person in the studio.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID
